controls.name: Understanding the organization and its context
controls.description: Determine internal and external issues relevant to purpose, strategic direction and ability to achieve intended QMS results.

controls.name: Understanding needs and expectations of interested parties
controls.description: Identify relevant interested parties (customers, regulators, partners, employees, investors) and their applicable requirements.

controls.name: Scope of the QMS
controls.description: Determine and document the scope of the QMS including products, services, locations and exclusions.

controls.name: QMS and its processes
controls.description: Establish, implement, maintain and continually improve the QMS, including processes, interactions, criteria, methods and resources.

controls.name: Leadership and commitment
controls.description: Top management demonstrates leadership and commitment to the QMS and customer focus.

controls.name: Quality policy – establishment
controls.description: Establish a quality policy appropriate to purpose and context, supporting strategic direction and continual improvement.

controls.name: Quality policy – communication
controls.description: Ensure the quality policy is communicated, understood, applied and available to interested parties.

controls.name: Organizational roles,responsibilities and authorities
controls.description: Assign and communicate responsibilities and authorities for QMS roles,including customer satisfaction and conformity.

controls.name: Actions to address risks and opportunities
controls.description: Determine risks and opportunities that need to be addressed to ensure the QMS can achieve intended results.

controls.name: Quality objectives
controls.description: Establish measurable quality objectives at relevant functions, levels and processes, consistent with the quality policy.

controls.name: Planning to achieve quality objectives
controls.description: Plan what will be done, resources, responsible persons, timelines and methods to achieve quality objectives.

controls.name: Planning of changes
controls.description: Carry out changes to the QMS in a planned manner, considering purpose, consequences, resources and integrity of the system.

controls.name: Resources, people, infrastructure and environment
controls.description: Determine and provide resources, people, infrastructure and work environment necessary for QMS and process operation.

controls.name: Monitoring and measuring resources
controls.description: Ensure suitability and maintenance of monitoring and measuring resources (including tools used to assess service and model performance).

controls.name: Organizational knowledge
controls.description: Determine and maintain knowledge necessary for process operation and conformity of services.

controls.name: Competence
controls.description: Determine required competence, ensure personnel are competent, and retain appropriate evidence.

controls.name: Awareness
controls.description: Ensure persons are aware of quality policy, objectives, their contribution and implications of nonconformities.

controls.name: Communication
controls.description: Determine internal and external QMS-related communications (what, when, with whom, how).

controls.name: Documented information
controls.description: Create, update and control documented information required by the QMS and ISO 9001.

controls.name: Operational planning and control
controls.description: Plan, implement and control processes to meet requirements, including criteria, resources and control of changes and outsourced processes.

controls.name: Customer communication and requirements determination
controls.description: Ensure effective communication with customers and clear determination of product and service requirements.

controls.name: Review of requirements for products and services
controls.description: Review customer requirements and ensure capability to meet them before committing.

controls.name: Design and development planning, inputs and controls
controls.description: Plan and control design and development of products and services, including stages, inputs, reviews, verification and validation.

controls.name: Design outputs and verification/validation
controls.description: Ensure design outputs meet input requirements and retain evidence of verification and validation.

controls.name: Design and development changes
controls.description: Identify, review and control changes made during or after design and development.

controls.name: Control of externally provided processes, products and services
controls.description: Ensure externally provided processes, products and services meet specified requirements.

controls.name: Control of production and service provision
controls.description: Implement controlled conditions for service provision, including documented information, suitable infrastructure, monitoring and competent people.

controls.name: Identification, traceability, customer property and preservation
controls.description: Where applicable, ensure identification/traceability, care of customer property and preservation of outputs.

controls.name: Control of changes in service provision
controls.description: Review and control changes affecting service provision to ensure continuing conformity.

controls.name: Release of products and services
controls.description: Implement planned arrangements to verify that requirements are met prior to release and retain evidence of release authorization.

controls.name: Control of nonconforming outputs
controls.description: Ensure nonconforming outputs are identified, controlled, corrected and recorded, including customer notification where relevant.

controls.name: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
controls.description: Determine what needs to be monitored and measured, methods, timing and evaluation of QMS performance and effectiveness.

controls.name: Customer satisfaction
controls.description: Monitor customers’ perceptions of the degree to which their needs and expectations have been fulfilled.

controls.name: Internal audit
controls.description: Conduct internal audits at planned intervals to provide information on QMS conformity and effectiveness.

controls.name: Management review
controls.description: Top management reviews the QMS at planned intervals, considering specified inputs and ensuring outputs include decisions and actions.

controls.name: Nonconformity and corrective action
controls.description: React to nonconformities, evaluate causes and implement corrective actions; review effectiveness and update risks.

controls.name: Continual improvement
controls.description: Continually improve the suitability, adequacy and effectiveness of the QMS.
